dianoite.h2: When the Day Ends, the House Lights Up.
dianoite.lead: Warm light on the wooden ceilings, a lit pool and the eco fireplace beside it.
dianoite.dia.p: Loungers beside the infinity-edge pool, with the sea just ahead.
dianoite.ent.p: Low light reaches the deck, the lawn and the lit pool.
dianoite.noi.p: The eco fireplace is lit by the pool and gathers up to 12 people.
